snippet.title: Taste of Heaven | Secret Sauce Showcase trailer
snippet.description:
A new trailer has released for 2D cooking RPG Taste Of Heaven, revealing the 6 romanceable characters that will be available when the game launches on PC in early 2027.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1835080/Taste_Of_Heaven/
